name: Olympic National Park
about: Jul–Sep is the reliably dry window, and Hurricane Ridge's road is weather-dependent and often closed on weekdays in winter.
overview: Temperate rainforest, rugged Pacific coastline and alpine peaks all in one park — genuinely three different ecosystems within a day's drive of each other.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels — a lakeside kayak rental at Lake Crescent is about the only real add-on beyond the standard park fees and gateway-town meals.

specialSeasons.text: The Hoh Rainforest lives up to its name most of the year — bring rain gear regardless of season.
